cer.normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, remove whitespace and Unicode punctuation except . - + % :; preserve negation and numbers
cer.full_set_cer: null if any expected item has no successful actual transcript; observed CER must be paired with coverage and missing/error/timeout counts
cer.reference: Human-verified transcript of actual authorized audio; planned reading script is not automatically ground truth

critical_items.automated: Literal normalized phrase occurrence counts; only a screening indicator
critical_items.human: Independent reviewer checks semantic negation, numbers, time and additions/omissions; literal phrase retention is not semantic correctness

rtf: compute_ms / actual audio_duration_ms; compute includes this worker operation's validation and generation/transcription boundary; queue time separate
ready: High-resolution monotonic worker time from enqueue to complete WAV available; not physical playback or streaming first-block time
streaming_first_block: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_C00; null until actual streaming engine emits a verified usable first block
memory: Actual worker process lifetime peak working set/RSS including Python and framework; not isolated per-request model allocation

tts_listening.method: Anonymous condition IDs, same playback volume policy, independent listener transcription and judgments; preserve each listener
tts_listening.negation_number_omission: Explicit human error flags, not inferred from AI opinion

statistics: Future real runs: at least 30 performance repeats, report p50/p95/max/errors/timeouts and paired comparisons; do not change frozen definitions based on final-test errors
contract_fixtures: Silence and non-speech tone only validate pipeline; never included as ASR/TTS quality or KV260 performance
runtime_truth: PC_REAL and BOARD_REAL are declared execution labels, not standalone proof of board execution
